verses.decoded: His clothes became shining, extremely white like snow, whiter than anyone on earth could make them.

verses.kjv: And there appeared unto them Elias with Moses: and they were talking with Jesus.
verses.decoded: Elijah and Moses appeared to them, and they were talking with Jesus.

verses.kjv: And Peter answered and said to Jesus, Master, it is good for us to be here: and let us make three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias.
verses.decoded: Peter said to Jesus, 'Teacher, it is good for us to be here. Let us make three shelters: one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.'

verses.kjv: For he wist not what to say; for they were sore afraid.
verses.decoded: He did not know what to say because they were very afraid.

verses.kjv: And there was a cloud that overshadowed them: and a voice came out of the cloud, saying, This is my beloved Son: hear him.
verses.decoded: Then a cloud covered them, and a voice came from the cloud, saying, 'This is my beloved Son. Listen to him.'

verses.kjv: And suddenly, when they had looked round about, they saw no man any more, save Jesus only with themselves.
verses.decoded: Suddenly, when they looked around, they saw no one except Jesus with them.

verses.kjv: And as they came down from the mountain, he charged them that they should tell no man what things they had seen, till the Son of man were risen from the dead.
verses.decoded: As they came down the mountain, Jesus told them not to tell anyone what they had seen until the Son of Man had risen from the dead.

verses.kjv: And they kept that saying with themselves, questioning one with another what the rising from the dead should mean.
verses.decoded: They kept this to themselves, asking each other what 'rising from the dead' meant.

verses.kjv: And they asked him, saying, Why say the scribes that Elias must first come?
verses.decoded: They asked him, 'Why do the teachers of the law say that Elijah must come first?'

verses.kjv: And he answered and told them, Elias verily cometh first, and restoreth all things; and how it is written of the Son of man, that he must suffer many things, and be set at nought.
verses.decoded: Jesus answered, 'Elijah does come first and restores everything. It is also written about the Son of Man that he must suffer much and be rejected.'

verses.kjv: But I say unto you, That Elias is indeed come, and they have done unto him whatsoever they listed, as it is written of him.
verses.decoded: But I tell you, Elijah has already come, and people did to him whatever they wanted, just as it is written about him.

verses.kjv: And when he came to his disciples, he saw a great multitude about them, and the scribes questioning with them.
verses.decoded: When Jesus came to his disciples, he saw a large crowd around them and the teachers of the law arguing with them.

verses.kjv: And straightway all the people, when they beheld him, were greatly amazed, and running to him saluted him.
verses.decoded: As soon as all the people saw Jesus, they were amazed and ran to greet him.

verses.kjv: And he asked the scribes, What question ye with them?
verses.decoded: Jesus asked the teachers, 'What are you arguing with them about?'

verses.kjv: And one of the multitude answered and said, Master, I have brought unto thee my son, which hath a dumb spirit;
verses.decoded: One man from the crowd answered, 'Teacher, I brought my son to you because he has a spirit that makes him unable to speak.'

verses.kjv: And wheresoever he taketh him, he teareth him: and he foameth, and gnasheth with his teeth, and pineth away: and I spake to thy disciples that they should cast him out; and they could not.
verses.decoded: Whenever the spirit seizes him, it throws him down, makes him foam at the mouth, grind his teeth, and become very weak. I asked your disciples to drive it out, but they could not.'

verses.kjv: He answereth him, and saith, O faithless generation, how long shall I be with you? how long shall I suffer you? bring him unto me.
verses.decoded: Jesus said, 'You unbelieving generation, how long must I be with you? How long must I put up with you? Bring the boy to me.'

verses.kjv: And they brought him unto him: and when he saw him, straightway the spirit tare him; and he fell on the ground, and wallowed foaming.
verses.decoded: They brought the boy to Jesus. When Jesus saw him, the spirit immediately threw the boy into a convulsion, and he fell to the ground, foaming at the mouth.

verses.kjv: And he asked his father, How long is it ago since this came unto him? And he said, Of a child.
verses.decoded: Jesus asked the boy's father, 'How long has this been happening?' He said, 'Since he was a child.'

verses.kjv: And ofttimes it hath cast him into the fire, and into the waters, to destroy him: but if thou canst do any thing, have compassion on us, and help us.
verses.decoded: The spirit often throws him into fire or water to kill him. But if you can do anything, have compassion on us and help us.'

verses.kjv: Jesus said unto him, If thou canst believe, all things are possible to him that believeth.
verses.decoded: Jesus said to him, 'If you can believe, everything is possible for the one who believes.'

verses.kjv: And straightway the father of the child cried out, and said with tears, Lord, I believe; help thou mine unbelief.
verses.decoded: Immediately the boy's father cried out, 'I believe; help my unbelief!'

verses.kjv: When Jesus saw that the people came running together, he rebuked the foul spirit, saying unto him, Thou dumb and deaf spirit, I charge thee, come out of him, and enter no more into him.
verses.decoded: When Jesus saw that a crowd was running to them, he rebuked the evil spirit, saying, 'You mute and deaf spirit, I command you, come out of him and never enter him again.'

verses.kjv: And the spirit cried, and rent him sore, and came out of him: and he was as one dead; insomuch that many said, He is dead.
verses.decoded: The spirit screamed, shook the boy violently, and came out. The boy looked dead, so many said, 'He is dead.'

verses.kjv: But Jesus took him by the hand, and lifted him up; and he arose.
verses.decoded: But Jesus took the boy by the hand and lifted him up, and he stood up.

verses.kjv: And when he was come into the house, his disciples asked him privately, Why could not we cast him out?
verses.decoded: When Jesus went indoors, his disciples asked him privately, 'Why couldn't we drive it out?'

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, This kind can come forth by nothing, but by prayer and fasting.
verses.decoded: Jesus said to them, 'This kind can come out only by prayer and fasting.'

verses.kjv: And they departed thence, and passed through Galilee; and he would not that any man should know it.
verses.decoded: They left that place and traveled through Galilee, but Jesus did not want anyone to know.

verses.kjv: For he taught his disciples, and said unto them, The Son of man is delivered into the hands of men, and they shall kill him; and after that he is killed, he shall rise the third day.
verses.decoded: He taught his disciples, saying, 'The Son of Man will be handed over to people, they will kill him, and after he is killed, he will rise on the third day.'

verses.kjv: But they understood not that saying, and were afraid to ask him.
verses.decoded: But they did not understand what he meant and were afraid to ask him.

verses.kjv: And he came to Capernaum: and being in the house he asked them, What was it that ye disputed among yourselves by the way?
verses.decoded: Jesus came to Capernaum. While he was in the house, he asked them, 'What were you arguing about on the way?'

verses.kjv: But they held their peace: for by the way they had disputed among themselves, who should be the greatest.
verses.decoded: But they kept quiet, because on the way they had been arguing about who would be the greatest.

verses.kjv: And he sat down, and called the twelve, and saith unto them, If any man desire to be first, the same shall be last of all, and servant of all.
verses.decoded: Jesus sat down, called the twelve disciples, and said to them, 'If anyone wants to be first, they must be last of all and serve everyone else.'

verses.kjv: And he took a child, and set him in the midst of them: and when he had taken him in his arms, he said unto them,
verses.decoded: He took a child and placed the child among them. Then he took the child in his arms and said to them,

verses.kjv: Whosoever shall receive one of such children in my name, receiveth me: and whosoever shall receive me, receiveth not me, but him that sent me.
verses.decoded: 'Anyone who welcomes one of these children in my name welcomes me. And anyone who welcomes me does not just welcome me but also welcomes the one who sent me.'

verses.kjv: And John answered him, saying, Master, we saw one casting out devils in thy name, and he followeth not us: and we forbad him, because he followeth not us.
verses.decoded: John answered him, 'Teacher, we saw someone driving out demons in your name, but he is not one of us. We told him to stop because he is not following us.'

verses.kjv: But Jesus said, Forbid him not: for there is no man which shall do a miracle in my name, that can lightly speak evil of me.
verses.decoded: Jesus said, 'Don't stop him! No one who does a miracle in my name can soon speak evil of me.

verses.kjv: For he that is not against us is on our part.
verses.decoded: Anyone who is not against us is for us.

verses.kjv: For whosoever shall give you a cup of water to drink in my name, because ye belong to Christ, verily I say unto you, he shall not lose his reward.
verses.decoded: If anyone gives you even a cup of water to drink because you belong to Christ, I tell you the truth, they will not lose their reward.'

verses.kjv: And whosoever shall offend one of these little ones that believe in me, it is better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and he were cast into the sea.
verses.decoded: 'If anyone causes one of these little ones who believe in me to sin, it would be better for them to have a large millstone tied around their neck and be thrown into the sea.'

verses.kjv: And if thy hand offend thee, cut it off: it is better for thee to enter into life maimed, than having two hands to go into hell, into the fire that never shall be quenched:
verses.decoded: 'If your hand causes you to sin, cut it off. It is better for you to enter life crippled than to have two hands and go to hell, where the fire never goes out.'

verses.kjv: Where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched.
verses.decoded: There their worm does not die, and the fire is not put out.

verses.kjv: And if thy foot offend thee, cut it off: it is better for thee to enter halt into life, than having two feet to be cast into hell, into the fire that never shall be quenched:
verses.decoded: 'If your foot causes you to sin, cut it off. It is better for you to enter life with one foot than to have two feet and be thrown into hell,

verses.kjv: Where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched.
verses.decoded: where their worm does not die, and the fire is not put out.'

verses.kjv: And if thine eye offend thee, pluck it out: it is better for thee to enter into the kingdom of God with one eye, than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire:
verses.decoded: 'If your eye causes you to sin, pluck it out. It is better for you to enter the kingdom of God with one eye than to have two eyes and be thrown into hell,

verses.kjv: Where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched.
verses.decoded: where their worm does not die, and the fire is not put out.'

verses.kjv: For every one shall be salted with fire, and every sacrifice shall be salted with salt.
verses.decoded: 'Everyone will be tested with fire, and every sacrifice will be seasoned with salt.

verses.kjv: Salt is good: but if the salt have lost his saltness, wherewith will ye season it? Have salt in yourselves, and have peace one with another.
verses.decoded: Salt is good, but if salt loses its saltiness, how can you make it salty again? Have salt in yourselves and live in peace with each other.'

verses.kjv: And he arose from thence, and cometh into the coasts of Judaea by the farther side of Jordan: and the people resort unto him again; and, as he was wont, he taught them again.
verses.decoded: Jesus left there and went into the region of Judea on the other side of the Jordan. People came to him again, and as usual, he taught them.

verses.kjv: And the Pharisees came to him, and asked him, Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife? tempting him.
verses.decoded: The Pharisees came to him and asked, 'Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife?' trying to test him.

verses.kjv: And he answered and said unto them, What did Moses command you?
verses.decoded: Jesus answered, 'What did Moses command you?'

verses.kjv: And they said, Moses suffered to write a bill of divorcement, and to put her away.
verses.decoded: They said, 'Moses allowed a man to write a certificate of divorce and send her away.'

verses.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto them, For the hardness of your heart he wrote you this precept.
verses.decoded: Jesus said to them, 'Moses allowed this because of your hard hearts.'

verses.kjv: But from the beginning of the creation God made them male and female.
verses.decoded: But from the beginning of creation, God made them male and female.

verses.kjv: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and cleave to his wife;
verses.decoded: For this reason, a man will leave his father and mother and be joined to his wife,

verses.kjv: And they twain shall be one flesh: so then they are no more twain, but one flesh.
verses.decoded: and the two will become one flesh. So they are no longer two, but one flesh.

verses.kjv: What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder.
verses.decoded: Therefore, what God has joined together, no one should separate.

verses.kjv: And in the house his disciples asked him again of the same matter.
verses.decoded: At home, the disciples asked Jesus about this again.

verses.kjv: And he saith unto them, Whosoever shall put away his wife, and marry another, committeth adultery against her.
verses.decoded: He said to them, 'Anyone who divorces his wife and marries another commits adultery against her.'

verses.kjv: And if a woman shall put away her husband, and be married to another, she committeth adultery.
verses.decoded: And if a woman divorces her husband and marries another, she commits adultery.

verses.kjv: And they brought young children to him, that he should touch them: and his disciples rebuked those that brought them.
verses.decoded: People were bringing little children to Jesus for him to touch them, but the disciples rebuked them.

verses.kjv: But when Jesus saw it, he was much displeased, and said unto them, Suffer the little children to come unto me, and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of God.
verses.decoded: When Jesus saw this, he was very upset and said, 'Let the little children come to me. Don’t stop them, because the kingdom of God belongs to those like them.'

verses.kjv: Verily I say unto you, Whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of God as a little child, he shall not enter therein.
verses.decoded: I tell you the truth, anyone who does not receive the kingdom of God like a little child will never enter it.

verses.kjv: And he took them up in his arms, put his hands upon them, and blessed them.
verses.decoded: Jesus took the children in his arms, placed his hands on them, and blessed them.

verses.kjv: And when he was gone forth into the way, there came one running, and kneeled to him, and asked him, Good Master, what shall I do that I may inherit eternal life?
verses.decoded: As Jesus was walking on the road, a man ran up, knelt before him, and asked, 'Good Teacher, what must I do to inherit eternal life?'

verses.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Why callest thou me good? there is none good but one, that is, God.
verses.decoded: Jesus said, 'Why do you call me good? No one is good except God alone.'

verses.kjv: Thou knowest the commandments, Do not commit adultery, Do not kill, Do not steal, Do not bear false witness, Defraud not, Honour thy father and mother.
verses.decoded: You know the commandments: Do not commit adultery, do not murder, do not steal, do not lie, do not cheat, honor your father and mother.

verses.kjv: And he answered and said unto him, Master, all these have I observed from my youth.
verses.decoded: The man said, 'Teacher, I have obeyed all these since I was young.'

verses.kjv: Then Jesus beholding him loved him, and said unto him, One thing thou lackest: go thy way, sell whatsoever thou hast, and give to the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come, take up the cross, and follow me.
verses.decoded: Jesus looked at him and loved him. He said, 'You still lack one thing. Go, sell everything you have, give the money to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven. Then come, follow me.'

verses.kjv: And he was sad at that saying, and went away grieved: for he had great possessions.
verses.decoded: The man was sad at this and went away grieving because he had many possessions.

verses.kjv: And Jesus looked round about, and saith unto his disciples, How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God!
verses.decoded: Jesus looked around and said to his disciples, 'How hard it is for the rich to enter the kingdom of God!'

verses.kjv: And the disciples were astonished at his words. But Jesus answereth again, and saith unto them, Children, how hard is it for them that trust in riches to enter into the kingdom of God!
verses.decoded: The disciples were amazed at his words. But Jesus said again, 'Children, how hard it is for those who trust in riches to enter the kingdom of God!'

verses.kjv: It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.
verses.decoded: It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for a rich person to enter God’s kingdom.

verses.kjv: And they were astonished out of measure, saying among themselves, Who then can be saved?
verses.decoded: The disciples were very surprised and asked each other, 'Who then can be saved?'

verses.kjv: And Jesus looking upon them saith, With men it is impossible, but not with God: for with God all things are possible.
verses.decoded: Jesus looked at them and said, 'With people it is impossible, but not with God. Everything is possible with God.'

verses.kjv: Then Peter began to say unto him, Lo, we have left all, and have followed thee.
verses.decoded: Peter spoke up, 'We have left everything and followed you.'

verses.kjv: And Jesus answered and said, Verily I say unto you, There is no man that hath left house, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my sake, and the gospel's,
verses.decoded: Jesus said, 'I tell you the truth, no one who has left home, brothers, sisters, father, mother, wife, children, or land for my sake and for the gospel

verses.kjv: But he shall receive an hundredfold now in this time, houses, and brethren, and sisters, and mothers, and children, and lands, with persecutions; and in the world to come eternal life.
verses.decoded: will fail to receive a hundred times as much now in this life—houses, brothers, sisters, mothers, children, and land—along with persecution. And in the age to come, eternal life.'

verses.kjv: But many that are first shall be last; and the last first.
verses.decoded: But many who are first will be last, and the last will be first.

verses.kjv: And they were in the way going up to Jerusalem; and Jesus went before them: and they were amazed; and as they followed, they were afraid. And he took again the twelve, and began to tell them what things should happen unto him,
verses.decoded: They were on the road going up to Jerusalem, with Jesus leading the way. The people were amazed, but also afraid as they followed. Jesus took the twelve disciples aside and began to tell them what would happen to him.

verses.kjv: Saying, Behold, we go up to Jerusalem; and the Son of man shall be delivered unto the chief priests, and unto the scribes; and they shall condemn him to death, and shall deliver him to the Gentiles:
verses.decoded: He said, 'Look, we are going up to Jerusalem, and the Son of Man will be handed over to the chief priests and teachers of the law. They will condemn him to death and hand him over to the Gentiles.'

verses.kjv: And they shall mock him, and shall scourge him, and shall spit upon him, and shall kill him: and the third day he shall rise again.
verses.decoded: They will mock him, beat him, spit on him, and kill him. But on the third day, he will rise again.

verses.kjv: And James and John, the sons of Zebedee, come unto him, saying, Master, we would that thou shouldest do for us whatsoever we shall desire.
verses.decoded: James and John, the sons of Zebedee, came to Jesus and said, 'Teacher, we want you to do whatever we ask.'

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, What would ye that I should do for you?
verses.decoded: Jesus asked them, 'What do you want me to do for you?'

verses.kjv: They said unto him, Grant unto us that we may sit, one on thy right hand, and the other on thy left hand, in thy glory.
verses.decoded: They said, 'Let one of us sit at your right side and the other at your left side in your glory.'

verses.kjv: But Jesus said unto them, Ye know not what ye ask: can ye drink of the cup that I drink of? and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?
verses.decoded: Jesus said to them, 'You don’t know what you are asking. Can you drink the cup I drink or be baptized with the baptism I am baptized with?'

verses.kjv: And they said unto him, We can. And Jesus said unto them, Ye shall indeed drink of the cup that I drink of; and with the baptism that I am baptized withal shall ye be baptized:
verses.decoded: They said, 'We can.' Jesus told them, 'You will drink the cup I drink and be baptized with the baptism I am baptized with.'

verses.kjv: But to sit on my right hand and on my left hand is not mine to give; but it shall be given to them for whom it is prepared.
verses.decoded: But to sit at my right or left is not for me to give. Those places are for those for whom they have been prepared.'

verses.kjv: And when the ten heard it, they began to be much displeased with James and John.
verses.decoded: When the other ten heard this, they became very upset with James and John.

verses.kjv: But Jesus called them to him, and saith unto them, Ye know that they which are accounted to rule over the Gentiles exercise lordship over them; and their great ones exercise authority upon them.
verses.decoded: Jesus called them together and said, 'You know that those who are considered rulers over the Gentiles lord it over them, and their high officials exercise authority over them.'

verses.kjv: But so shall it not be among you: but whosoever will be great among you, shall be your minister:
verses.decoded: But it will not be like that among you. Instead, whoever wants to be great among you must be your servant.

verses.kjv: And whosoever of you will be the chiefest, shall be servant of all.
verses.decoded: And whoever wants to be first must be the servant of all.

verses.kjv: For even the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.
verses.decoded: For even the Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.'

verses.kjv: And they came to Jericho: and as he went out of Jericho with his disciples and a great number of people, blind Bartimaeus, the son of Timaeus, sat by the highway side begging.
verses.decoded: They came to Jericho. As Jesus and his disciples and a large crowd were leaving Jericho, a blind man named Bartimaeus, the son of Timaeus, was sitting by the roadside begging.

verses.kjv: And when he heard that it was Jesus of Nazareth, he began to cry out, and say, Jesus, thou Son of David, have mercy on me.
verses.decoded: When he heard that it was Jesus of Nazareth, he began to shout, 'Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me!'

verses.kjv: And many charged him that he should hold his peace: but he cried the more a great deal, Thou Son of David, have mercy on me.
verses.decoded: Many told him to be quiet, but he shouted even louder, 'Son of David, have mercy on me!'

verses.kjv: And Jesus stood still, and commanded him to be called. And they call the blind man, saying unto him, Be of good comfort, rise; he calleth thee.
verses.decoded: Jesus stopped and said, 'Call him.' So they called the blind man, saying, 'Cheer up! Come on, he is calling you.'

verses.kjv: And he, casting away his garment, rose, and came to Jesus.
verses.decoded: Throwing off his cloak, he jumped up and came to Jesus.

verses.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto him, What wilt thou that I should do unto thee? The blind man said unto him, Lord, that I might receive my sight.
verses.decoded: Jesus asked him, 'What do you want me to do for you?' The blind man said, 'Lord, I want to see.'

verses.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Go thy way; thy faith hath made thee whole. And immediately he received his sight, and followed Jesus in the way.
verses.decoded: Jesus said, 'Go, your faith has healed you.' Immediately he received his sight and followed Jesus on the road.

verses.kjv: And when they came nigh to Jerusalem, unto Bethphage and Bethany, at the mount of Olives, he sendeth forth two of his disciples,
verses.decoded: When they got near Jerusalem, to Bethphage and Bethany on the Mount of Olives, Jesus sent two of his followers ahead.

verses.kjv: And saith unto them, Go your way into the village over against you: and as soon as ye be entered into it, ye shall find a colt tied, whereon never man sat; loose him, and bring him.
verses.decoded: He said to them, 'Go to the village across from you. As soon as you enter it, you will find a young donkey tied there that no one has ever ridden. Untie it and bring it here.'

verses.kjv: And if any man say unto you, Why do ye this? say ye that the Lord hath need of him; and straightway he will send him hither.
verses.decoded: If anyone asks you, 'Why are you doing this?' say, 'The Lord needs it,' and they will let it go at once.

verses.kjv: And they went their way, and found the colt tied by the door without in a place where two ways met; and they loose him.
verses.decoded: They went and found the young donkey tied at the gate where two roads met, and they untied it.

verses.kjv: And certain of them that stood there said unto them, What do ye, loosing the colt?
verses.decoded: Some people standing there asked, 'What are you doing untying that young donkey?'

verses.kjv: And they said unto them even as Jesus had commanded: and they let them go.
verses.decoded: They answered just as Jesus had told them, and those people let them go.

verses.kjv: And they brought the colt to Jesus, and cast their garments on him; and he sat upon him.
verses.decoded: They brought the donkey to Jesus, threw their coats on it, and he sat on it.

verses.kjv: And many spread their garments in the way: and others cut down branches off the trees, and strawed them in the way.
verses.decoded: Many people spread their coats on the road, while others cut branches from the trees and spread them on the road.

verses.kjv: And they that went before, and they that followed, cried, saying, Hosanna; Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord:
verses.decoded: Those walking in front and those following behind shouted, 'Hosanna! Blessed is the one who comes in the name of the Lord!'

verses.kjv: Blessed be the kingdom of our father David, that cometh in the name of the Lord: Hosanna in the highest.
verses.decoded: 'Blessed is the kingdom of our father David that is coming! Hosanna in the highest!'

verses.kjv: And Jesus entered into Jerusalem, and into the temple: and when he had looked round about upon all things, and now the eventide was come, he went out unto Bethany with the twelve.
verses.decoded: Jesus entered Jerusalem and went into the temple. After looking around at everything, since it was late, he left for Bethany with the twelve disciples.

verses.kjv: And on the morrow, when they were come from Bethany, he was hungry:
verses.decoded: The next day, as they left Bethany, Jesus was hungry.

verses.kjv: And seeing a fig tree afar off having leaves, he came, if haply he might find any thing thereon: and when he came to it, he found nothing but leaves; for the time of figs was not yet.
verses.decoded: He saw a fig tree in the distance with leaves and went to see if it had any fruit. When he got there, he found only leaves because it was not the season for figs.

verses.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto it, No man eat fruit of thee hereafter for ever. And his disciples heard it.
verses.decoded: Jesus said to the tree, 'No one will ever eat fruit from you again.' His disciples heard this.

verses.kjv: And they come to Jerusalem: and Jesus went into the temple, and began to cast out them that sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers, and the seats of them that sold doves;
verses.decoded: They came to Jerusalem, and Jesus went into the temple. He began driving out those who were buying and selling there. He overturned the tables of the money changers and the benches of those selling doves.

verses.kjv: And would not suffer that any man should carry any vessel through the temple.
verses.decoded: He would not allow anyone to carry anything through the temple.

verses.kjv: And he taught, saying unto them, Is it not written, My house shall be called of all nations the house of prayer? but ye have made it a den of thieves.
verses.decoded: He taught them, 'Is it not written, My house will be called a house of prayer for all nations? But you have made it a den of thieves.'

verses.kjv: And the scribes and chief priests heard it, and sought how they might destroy him: for they feared him, because all the people was astonished at his doctrine.
verses.decoded: The teachers of the law and the chief priests heard this and wanted to kill him because they were afraid. The people were amazed at his teaching.

verses.kjv: And when even was come, he went out of the city.
verses.decoded: When evening came, Jesus left the city.

verses.kjv: And in the morning, as they passed by, they saw the fig tree dried up from the roots.
verses.decoded: The next morning, as they passed by, they saw the fig tree had dried up from the roots.

verses.kjv: And Peter calling to remembrance saith unto him, Master, behold, the fig tree which thou cursedst is withered away.
verses.decoded: Peter remembered and said to Jesus, 'Teacher, look! The fig tree you cursed has withered.'

verses.kjv: And Jesus answering saith unto them, Have faith in God.
verses.decoded: Jesus answered, 'Have faith in God.'

verses.kjv: For verily I say unto you, That whosoever shall say unto this mountain, Be thou removed, and be thou cast into the sea; and shall not doubt in his heart, but shall believe that those things which he saith shall come to pass; he shall have whatsoever he saith.
verses.decoded: I tell you the truth, if anyone says to this mountain, 'Go, throw yourself into the sea,' and does not doubt in their heart but believes what they say will happen, it will be done for them.

verses.kjv: Therefore I say unto you, What things soever ye desire, when ye pray, believe that ye receive them, and ye shall have them.
verses.decoded: So I tell you, whatever you ask for in prayer, believe that you have received it, and it will be yours.

verses.kjv: And when ye stand praying, forgive, if ye have ought against any: that your Father also which is in heaven may forgive you your trespasses.
verses.decoded: When you stand praying, forgive anyone you are holding a grudge against, so that your Father in heaven will forgive your sins too.

verses.kjv: But if ye do not forgive, neither will your Father which is in heaven forgive your trespasses.
verses.decoded: But if you do not forgive, your Father in heaven will not forgive your sins.

verses.kjv: And they come again to Jerusalem: and as he was walking in the temple, there come to him the chief priests, and the scribes, and the elders,
verses.decoded: They returned to Jerusalem, and while Jesus was walking in the temple, the chief priests, teachers of the law, and elders came to him.

verses.kjv: And say unto him, By what authority doest thou these things? and who gave thee this authority to do these things?
verses.decoded: They asked, 'By what authority are you doing these things? Who gave you the authority to do this?'

verses.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto them, I will also ask of you one question, and answer me, and I will tell you by what authority I do these things.
verses.decoded: Jesus answered, 'I will ask you one question. Answer me, and I will tell you by what authority I do these things.' the winefat, and built a tower, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into a far country.

verses.kjv: The baptism of John, was it from heaven, or of men? answer me.
verses.decoded: 'Was John's baptism from heaven or from men? Tell me.'

verses.kjv: And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say, Why then did ye not believe him?
verses.decoded: They thought to themselves, 'If we say, From heaven, he will ask, Why didn’t you believe him then?'

verses.kjv: But if we shall say, Of men; they feared the people: for all men counted John, that he was a prophet indeed.
verses.decoded: But if we say, From people, they are afraid of the crowd, because everyone believes John was truly a prophet.

verses.kjv: And they answered and said unto Jesus, We cannot tell. And Jesus answering saith unto them, Neither do I tell you by what authority I do these things.
verses.decoded: So they answered Jesus, 'We don’t know.' Jesus replied, 'I won’t tell you by what authority I do these things either.'

verses.kjv: And at the season he sent to the husbandmen a servant, that he might receive from the husbandmen of the fruit of the vineyard.
verses.decoded: When it was time to collect the fruit, he sent a servant to the farmers to get his share of the grapes.

verses.kjv: And they caught him, and beat him, and sent him away empty.
verses.decoded: But they grabbed the servant, beat him, and sent him away empty-handed.

verses.kjv: And again he sent unto them another servant; and at him they cast stones, and wounded him in the head, and sent him away shamefully handled.
verses.decoded: He sent another servant, but they threw stones at him, injured his head, and sent him away badly treated.

verses.kjv: And again he sent another; and him they killed, and many others; beating some, and killing some.
verses.decoded: He sent a third servant, and they killed him. They also beat some servants and killed others.

verses.kjv: Having yet therefore one son, his wellbeloved, he sent him also last unto them, saying, They will reverence my son.
verses.decoded: The owner still had one son, whom he loved. So he sent him last, thinking they would respect his son.

verses.kjv: But those husbandmen said among themselves, This is the heir; come, let us kill him, and the inheritance shall be our's.
verses.decoded: But the farmers said to each other, 'This is the heir. Let's kill him so the inheritance will be ours.'

verses.kjv: And they took him, and killed him, and cast him out of the vineyard.
verses.decoded: So they grabbed the son, killed him, and threw him out of the vineyard.

verses.kjv: What shall therefore the lord of the vineyard do? he will come and destroy the husbandmen, and will give the vineyard unto others.
verses.decoded: What will the owner of the vineyard do? He will come, destroy those farmers, and give the vineyard to others.

verses.kjv: And have ye not read this scripture; The stone which the builders rejected is become the head of the corner:
verses.decoded: Haven't you read this scripture: 'The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone'?

verses.kjv: This was the Lord's doing, and it is marvellous in our eyes?
verses.decoded: This was the Lord's doing, and it is amazing to us.

verses.kjv: And they sought to lay hold on him, but feared the people: for they knew that he had spoken the parable against them: and they left him, and went their way.
verses.decoded: They wanted to arrest Jesus, but they were afraid of the crowd because they knew the story was about them. So they left him and went away.

verses.kjv: And they send unto him certain of the Pharisees and of the Herodians, to catch him in his words.
verses.decoded: Then some Pharisees and Herod supporters came to Jesus to trap him with his own words.

verses.kjv: And when they were come, they say unto him, Master, we know that thou art true, and carest for no man: for thou regardest not the person of men, but teachest the way of God in truth: Is it lawful to give tribute to Caesar, or not?
verses.decoded: They said, 'Teacher, we know you are honest and don’t care about what people think, because you teach God's way truthfully. Is it right to pay taxes to Caesar or not?'

verses.kjv: Shall we give, or shall we not give? But he, knowing their hypocrisy, said unto them, Why tempt ye me? bring me a penny, that I may see it.
verses.decoded: Should we pay or not? Jesus knew they were trying to trick him, so he said, 'Why are you trying to trap me? Show me a coin so I can see it.'

verses.kjv: And they brought it. And he saith unto them, Whose is this image and superscription? And they said unto him, Caesar's.
verses.decoded: They brought a coin, and he asked, 'Whose picture and name are on this?' They answered, 'Caesar’s.'

verses.kjv: And Jesus answering said unto them, Render to Caesar the things that are Caesar's, and to God the things that are God's. And they marvelled at him.
verses.decoded: Jesus said, 'Give to Caesar what belongs to Caesar, and give to God what belongs to God.' They were amazed at him.

verses.kjv: Then come unto him the Sadducees, which say there is no resurrection; and they asked him, saying,
verses.decoded: Then the Sadducees, who say there is no resurrection, came to Jesus and asked him a question.

verses.kjv: Master, Moses wrote unto us, If a man's brother die, and leave his wife behind him, and leave no children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.
verses.decoded: They said, 'Teacher, Moses wrote that if a man dies without children, his brother should marry the widow to have children for his brother.'

verses.kjv: Now there were seven brethren: and the first took a wife, and dying left no seed.
verses.decoded: There were seven brothers. The first married a woman but died without children.

verses.kjv: And the second took her, and died, neither left he any seed: and the third likewise.
verses.decoded: The second brother married her and died without children, and the same happened with the third.

verses.kjv: And the seven had her, and left no seed: last of all the woman died also.
verses.decoded: All seven brothers married her but left no children. Finally, the woman died too.

verses.kjv: In the resurrection therefore, when they shall rise, whose wife shall she be of them? for the seven had her to wife.
verses.decoded: At the resurrection, whose wife will she be since all seven were married to her?

verses.kjv: For when they shall rise from the dead, they neither marry, nor are given in marriage; but are as the angels which are in heaven.
verses.decoded: When people rise from the dead, they won’t marry or be married. They will be like angels in heaven.

verses.kjv: And as touching the dead, that they rise: have ye not read in the book of Moses, how in the bush God spake unto him, saying, I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob?
verses.decoded: Haven’t you read in Moses’ book that God spoke to him from the burning bush, saying, "I am the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob"?

verses.kjv: He is not the God of the dead, but the God of the living: ye therefore do greatly err.
verses.decoded: God is not the God of the dead but of the living. So you are greatly mistaken.

verses.kjv: And one of the scribes came, and having heard them reasoning together, and perceiving that he had answered them well, asked him, Which is the first commandment of all?
verses.decoded: One of the teachers of the law heard their discussion and saw Jesus answered well. He asked, 'Which is the most important commandment?'

verses.kjv: And Jesus answered him, The first of all the commandments is, Hear, O Israel; The Lord our God is one Lord:
verses.decoded: Jesus replied, 'The most important commandment is: Listen, Israel, the Lord our God is the only Lord.'

verses.kjv: And thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind, and with all thy strength: this is the first commandment.
verses.decoded: You must love the Lord your God with all your heart, all your soul, all your mind, and all your strength. This is the first commandment.

verses.kjv: And the second is like, namely this, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself. There is none other commandment greater than these.
verses.decoded: The second is like it: Love your neighbor as yourself. No other commandment is greater than these.

verses.kjv: And the scribe said unto him, Well, Master, thou hast said the truth: for there is one God; and there is none other but he:
verses.decoded: The expert in the law said to him, 'Well said, Teacher. You are right: there is only one God, and no one else besides him.'

verses.kjv: And to love him with all the heart, and with all the understanding, and with all the soul, and with all the strength, and to love his neighbour as himself, is more than all whole burnt offerings and sacrifices.
verses.decoded: To love God with all your heart, all your understanding, all your soul, and all your strength, and to love your neighbor as yourself, is more important than all burnt offerings and sacrifices.

verses.kjv: And when Jesus saw that he answered discreetly, he said unto him, Thou art not far from the kingdom of God. And no man after that durst ask him any question.
verses.decoded: When Jesus saw that he answered wisely, he said to him, 'You are not far from the kingdom of God.' After that, no one dared to ask him any more questions.

verses.kjv: And Jesus answered and said, while he taught in the temple, How say the scribes that Christ is the Son of David?
verses.decoded: While Jesus was teaching in the temple, he said, 'How do the experts in the law say that the Messiah is the Son of David?'

verses.kjv: For David himself said by the Holy Ghost, The LORD said to my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand, till I make thine enemies thy footstool.
verses.decoded: For David himself said by the Holy Spirit, 'The Lord said to my Lord, Sit at my right side until I put your enemies under your feet.'

verses.kjv: David therefore himself calleth him Lord; and whence is he then his son? And the common people heard him gladly.
verses.decoded: So David calls him Lord. How then can he be his son? The common people listened to him gladly.

verses.kjv: And he said unto them in his doctrine, Beware of the scribes, which love to go in long clothing, and love salutations in the marketplaces,
verses.decoded: Jesus said to them in his teaching, 'Watch out for the experts in the law who like to wear long robes and enjoy greetings in the marketplaces,

verses.kjv: And the chief seats in the synagogues, and the uppermost rooms at feasts:
verses.decoded: and the best seats in the synagogues and places of honor at banquets.

verses.kjv: Which devour widows' houses, and for a pretence make long prayers: these shall receive greater damnation.
verses.decoded: They take advantage of widows and make long prayers just to be seen. They will receive greater punishment.'

verses.kjv: And Jesus sat over against the treasury, and beheld how the people cast money into the treasury: and many that were rich cast in much.
verses.decoded: Jesus sat near the treasury and watched how people put money into it. Many rich people put in large amounts.

verses.kjv: And there came a certain poor widow, and she threw in two mites, which make a farthing.
verses.decoded: A poor widow came and put in two small coins, which are worth very little.

verses.kjv: And he called unto him his disciples, and saith unto them, Verily I say unto you, That this poor widow hath cast more in, than all they which have cast into the treasury:
verses.decoded: Calling his disciples to him, Jesus said, 'I tell you the truth, this poor widow has put in more than all the others who gave money to the treasury.'

verses.kjv: For all they did cast in of their abundance; but she of her want did cast in all that she had, even all her living.
verses.decoded: They all gave from their wealth, but she gave from her poverty all she had to live on.

verses.kjv: And as he went out of the temple, one of his disciples saith unto him, Master, see what manner of stones and what buildings are here!
verses.decoded: As Jesus left the temple, one of his followers said to him, Teacher, look at the stones and buildings here!

verses.kjv: And Jesus answering said unto him, Seest thou these great buildings? there shall not be left one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.
verses.decoded: Jesus answered, 'Do you see these large buildings? Not one stone will be left on another; they will all be thrown down.'

verses.kjv: And as he sat upon the mount of Olives over against the temple, Peter and James and John and Andrew asked him privately,
verses.decoded: While sitting on the Mount of Olives facing the temple, Peter, James, John, and Andrew asked him privately,

verses.kjv: Tell us, when shall these things be? and what shall be the sign when all these things shall be fulfilled?
verses.decoded: 'Tell us, when will these things happen? What will be the sign that all these things are about to be fulfilled?'

verses.kjv: And Jesus answering them began to say, Take heed lest any man deceive you:
verses.decoded: Jesus began to answer them, 'Be careful that no one deceives you.'

verses.kjv: For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many.
verses.decoded: Many will come in my name, saying, 'I am the Messiah,' and they will deceive many.

verses.kjv: And when ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars, be ye not troubled: for such things must needs be; but the end shall not be yet.
verses.decoded: When you hear about wars and rumors of wars, don’t be alarmed. These things must happen, but the end is not yet.

verses.kjv: For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be earthquakes in divers places, and there shall be famines and troubles: these are the beginnings of sorrows.
verses.decoded: Nation will fight against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. There will be earthquakes in many places, famines, and troubles. These are the beginning of sorrows.

verses.kjv: But take heed to yourselves: for they shall deliver you up to councils; and in the synagogues ye shall be beaten: and ye shall be brought before rulers and kings for my sake, for a testimony against them.
verses.decoded: But watch yourselves. You will be handed over to councils, beaten in synagogues, and brought before rulers and kings because of me, as a witness to them.

verses.kjv: And the gospel must first be published among all nations.
verses.decoded: The good news must first be preached to all nations.

verses.kjv: But when they shall lead you, and deliver you up, take no thought beforehand what ye shall speak, neither do ye premeditate: but whatsoever shall be given you in that hour, that speak ye: for it is not ye that speak, but the Holy Ghost.
verses.decoded: When they arrest you and bring you to trial, don’t worry beforehand about what to say. Just say whatever is given to you at that time, because it is not you speaking, but the Holy Spirit.

verses.kjv: Now the brother shall betray the brother to death, and the father the son; and children shall rise up against their parents, and shall cause them to be put to death.
verses.decoded: Brothers will betray brothers to death, and fathers will betray their children. Children will rise against their parents and cause them to be killed.

verses.kjv: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name's sake: but he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.
verses.decoded: You will be hated by everyone because of my name. But the one who endures to the end will be saved.

verses.kjv: But when ye shall see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, standing where it ought not, (let him that readeth understand,) then let them that be in Judaea flee to the mountains:
verses.decoded: When you see the abomination that causes destruction, spoken of by the prophet Daniel, standing where it should not be (let the reader understand), then those in Judea must flee to the mountains.

verses.kjv: And let him that is on the housetop not go down into the house, neither enter therein, to take any thing out of his house:
verses.decoded: Anyone on the roof must not go down or enter the house to get anything.

verses.kjv: And let him that is in the field not turn back again for to take up his garment.
verses.decoded: Anyone in the field must not turn back to get their coat.

verses.kjv: But woe to them that are with child, and to them that give suck in those days!
verses.decoded: How terrible it will be for pregnant women and nursing mothers at that time!

verses.kjv: And pray ye that your flight be not in the winter.
verses.decoded: Pray that your escape will not be in winter.

verses.kjv: For in those days shall be affliction, such as was not from the beginning of the creation which God created unto this time, neither shall be.
verses.decoded: Because those days will be a time of suffering unlike anything since the beginning of creation, which God made, until now—and never will be again.

verses.kjv: And except that the Lord had shortened those days, no flesh should be saved: but for the elect's sake, whom he hath chosen, he hath shortened the days.
verses.decoded: If the Lord had not shortened those days, no one would survive. But for the sake of his chosen people, he has shortened them.

verses.kjv: And then if any man shall say to you, Lo, here is Christ; or, lo, he is there; believe him not:
verses.decoded: If anyone tells you, 'Look, here is the Messiah,' or 'Look, he is there,' do not believe it.

verses.kjv: For false Christs and false prophets shall rise, and shall shew signs and wonders, to seduce, if it were possible, even the elect.
verses.decoded: False messiahs and false prophets will appear and perform signs and wonders to deceive, if possible, even God’s chosen people.

verses.kjv: But take ye heed: behold, I have foretold you all things.
verses.decoded: Be careful. I have told you everything ahead of time.

verses.kjv: But in those days, after that tribulation, the sun shall be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light,
verses.decoded: But in those days, after that suffering, the sun will be darkened, and the moon will not give its light.

verses.kjv: And the stars of heaven shall fall, and the powers that are in heaven shall be shaken.
verses.decoded: The stars in the sky will fall, and the powers in heaven will be shaken.

verses.kjv: And then shall they see the Son of man coming in the clouds with great power and glory.
verses.decoded: Then people will see the Son of Man coming in the clouds with great power and glory.

verses.kjv: And then shall he send his angels, and shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from the uttermost part of the earth to the uttermost part of heaven.
verses.decoded: He will send his angels and gather his chosen people from the four winds, from the farthest parts of the earth to the farthest parts of heaven.

verses.kjv: Now learn a parable of the fig tree; When her branch is yet tender, and putteth forth leaves, ye know that summer is near:
verses.decoded: Learn this lesson from the fig tree: When its branches become tender and put out leaves, you know that summer is near.

verses.kjv: So ye in like manner, when ye shall see these things come to pass, know that it is nigh, even at the doors.
verses.decoded: In the same way, when you see these things happening, know that it is near, right at the door.

verses.kjv: Verily I say unto you, that this generation shall not pass, till all these things be done.
verses.decoded: I tell you the truth, this generation will not pass away until all these things happen.

verses.kjv: Heaven and earth shall pass away: but my words shall not pass away.
verses.decoded: Heaven and earth will disappear, but my words will never disappear.

verses.kjv: But of that day and that hour knoweth no man, no, not the angels which are in heaven, neither the Son, but the Father.
verses.decoded: No one knows the day or hour, not even the angels in heaven, and not even the Son, only the Father knows.

verses.kjv: Take ye heed, watch and pray: for ye know not when the time is.
verses.decoded: Be careful, stay alert, and pray, because you don't know when the time will come.

verses.kjv: For the Son of man is as a man taking a far journey, who left his house, and gave authority to his servants, and to every man his work, and commanded the porter to watch.
verses.decoded: The Son of Man is like a man going on a long trip. He left his house, gave authority to his servants, assigned each one a task, and told the gatekeeper to stay alert.

verses.kjv: Watch ye therefore: for ye know not when the master of the house cometh, at even, or at midnight, or at the cockcrowing, or in the morning:
verses.decoded: So stay alert, because you don't know when the owner of the house will come—whether in the evening, at midnight, when the rooster crows, or in the morning.

verses.kjv: Lest coming suddenly he find you sleeping.
verses.decoded: Otherwise, he might come suddenly and find you sleeping.

verses.kjv: And what I say unto you I say unto all, Watch.
verses.decoded: What I say to you, I say to everyone: Stay alert.

verses.kjv: After two days was the feast of the passover, and of unleavened bread: and the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might take him by craft, and put him to death.
verses.decoded: In two days the Passover and the Festival of Unleavened Bread would begin. The leading priests and teachers of the law were looking for a way to arrest Jesus secretly and kill him.

verses.kjv: But they said, Not on the feast day, lest there be an uproar of the people.
verses.decoded: But they said, 'Not during the festival, or the people might start a riot.'

verses.kjv: And being in Bethany in the house of Simon the leper, as he sat at meat, there came a woman having an alabaster box of ointment of spikenard very precious; and she brake the box, and poured it on his head.
verses.decoded: While Jesus was in Bethany at the home of Simon the man with leprosy, a woman came with a jar of very expensive perfume made from spikenard. She broke the jar and poured the perfume on his head as he was eating.

verses.kjv: And there were some that had indignation within themselves, and said, Why was this waste of the ointment made?
verses.decoded: Some of those present were angry and said to each other, 'Why waste this perfume like that?'

verses.kjv: For it might have been sold for more than three hundred pence, and have been given to the poor. And they murmured against her.
verses.decoded: It could have been sold for more than 300 silver coins and the money given to the poor. They complained about her.

verses.kjv: And Jesus said, Let her alone; why trouble ye her? she hath wrought a good work on me.
verses.decoded: But Jesus said, 'Leave her alone. Why are you bothering her? She has done a good thing for me.

verses.kjv: For ye have the poor with you always, and whensoever ye will ye may do them good: but me ye have not always.
verses.decoded: You will always have the poor with you, and you can help them whenever you want, but you will not always have me.

verses.kjv: She hath done what she could: she is come aforehand to anoint my body to the burying.
verses.decoded: She has done what she could. She has come ahead of time to prepare my body for burial.

verses.kjv: And Judas Iscariot, one of the twelve, went unto the chief priests, to betray him unto them.
verses.decoded: Then Judas Iscariot, one of the twelve disciples, went to the leading priests to hand Jesus over to them.

verses.kjv: And when they heard it, they were glad, and promised to give him money. And he sought how he might conveniently betray him.
verses.decoded: When they heard this, they were happy and promised to pay him money. Judas was looking for a good opportunity to betray Jesus.

verses.kjv: And the first day of unleavened bread, when they killed the passover, his disciples said unto him, Where wilt thou that we go and prepare that thou mayest eat the passover?
verses.decoded: On the first day of the Festival of Unleavened Bread, when the Passover lamb was to be killed, Jesus’ disciples asked him, 'Where do you want us to go and prepare for you to eat the Passover meal?'

verses.kjv: And he sendeth forth two of his disciples, and saith unto them, Go ye into the city, and there shall meet you a man bearing a pitcher of water: follow him.
verses.decoded: Jesus sent two of his disciples and said to them, 'Go into the city, and a man carrying a jar of water will meet you. Follow him.

verses.kjv: And wheresoever he shall go in, say ye to the goodman of the house, The Master saith, Where is the guestchamber, where I shall eat the passover with my disciples?
verses.decoded: Wherever he goes, say to the owner of the house, “The Teacher asks, ‘Where is the guest room where I can eat the Passover meal with my disciples?’”'

verses.kjv: And he will shew you a large upper room furnished and prepared: there make ready for us.
verses.decoded: He will show you a large upstairs room that is ready. Prepare the meal there for us.'

verses.kjv: And his disciples went forth, and came into the city, and found as he had said unto them: and they made ready the passover.
verses.decoded: The disciples went into the city and found everything just as Jesus had told them. They prepared the Passover meal.

verses.kjv: And in the evening he cometh with the twelve.
verses.decoded: That evening Jesus came with the twelve disciples.

verses.kjv: And as they sat and did eat, Jesus said, Verily I say unto you, One of you which eateth with me shall betray me.
verses.decoded: While they were eating, Jesus said, 'I tell you the truth, one of you who is eating with me will betray me.'

verses.kjv: And they began to be sorrowful, and to say unto him one by one, Is it I? and another said, Is it I?
verses.decoded: They were very sad and began to ask him one after another, 'Surely not I?'

verses.kjv: And he answered and said unto them, It is one of the twelve, that dippeth with me in the dish.
verses.decoded: Jesus answered, 'It is one of the twelve, one who is dipping bread into the bowl with me.

verses.kjv: The Son of man indeed goeth, as it is written of him: but woe to that man by whom the Son of man is betrayed! good were it for that man if he had never been born.
verses.decoded: The Son of Man will go just as it is written about him, but how terrible it will be for the one who betrays him! It would be better for that person if he had never been born.'

verses.kjv: And as they did eat, Jesus took bread, and blessed, and brake it, and gave to them, and said, Take, eat: this is my body.
verses.decoded: While they were eating, Jesus took bread, gave thanks, broke it, and gave it to them. He said, 'Take it and eat. This is my body.'

verses.kjv: And he took the cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave it to them: and they all drank of it.
verses.decoded: Then he took a cup, gave thanks, and gave it to them, and they all drank from it.

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, This is my blood of the new testament, which is shed for many.
verses.decoded: He said to them, 'This is my blood of the new agreement, which is poured out for many.'

verses.kjv: Verily I say unto you, I will drink no more of the fruit of the vine, until that day that I drink it new in the kingdom of God.
verses.decoded: I tell you the truth, I will not drink wine again until the day I drink it new in God’s kingdom.'

verses.kjv: And when they had sung an hymn, they went out into the mount of Olives.
verses.decoded: After singing a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.

verses.kjv: And Jesus saith unto them, All ye shall be offended because of me this night: for it is written, I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep shall be scattered.
verses.decoded: Jesus said to them, 'Tonight all of you will fall away because of me. It is written, “I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered.”'

verses.kjv: But after that I am risen, I will go before you into Galilee.
verses.decoded: But after I rise, I will go ahead of you to Galilee.'

verses.kjv: But Peter said unto him, Although all shall be offended, yet will not I.
verses.decoded: Peter said to Jesus, 'Even if everyone else falls away, I will not.'

verses.kjv: And Jesus saith unto him, Verily I say unto thee, That this day, even in this night, before the cock crow twice, thou shalt deny me thrice.
verses.decoded: Jesus said to him, 'I tell you the truth, before the rooster crows twice tonight, you will deny me three times.'

verses.kjv: But he spake the more vehemently, If I should die with thee, I will not deny thee in any wise. Likewise also said they all.
verses.decoded: But Peter insisted more strongly, 'Even if I have to die with you, I will never deny you!' And all the others said the same.

verses.kjv: And they came to a place which was named Gethsemane: and he saith to his disciples, Sit ye here, while I shall pray.
verses.decoded: They went to a place called Gethsemane, and Jesus said to his disciples, 'Sit here while I pray.'

verses.kjv: And he taketh with him Peter and James and John, and began to be sore amazed, and to be very heavy;
verses.decoded: He took Peter, James, and John with him, and he began to feel deeply troubled and very sad.

verses.kjv: And saith unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful unto death: tarry ye here, and watch.
verses.decoded: He said to them, 'My soul is overwhelmed with sorrow to the point of death. Stay here and keep watch.'

verses.kjv: And he went forward a little, and fell on the ground, and prayed that, if it were possible, the hour might pass from him.
verses.decoded: He went a little farther, fell to the ground, and prayed that if it was possible, this hour might pass from him.

verses.kjv: And he said, Abba, Father, all things are possible unto thee; take away this cup from me: nevertheless not what I will, but what thou wilt.
verses.decoded: He said, 'Abba, Father, everything is possible for you. Please take this cup away from me. But not what I want, but what you want.'

verses.kjv: And he cometh, and findeth them sleeping, and saith unto Peter, Simon, sleepest thou? couldest not thou watch one hour?
verses.decoded: He came back and found them sleeping. He said to Peter, 'Simon, are you sleeping? Couldn’t you keep watch for one hour?'

verses.kjv: Watch ye and pray, lest ye enter into temptation. The spirit truly is ready, but the flesh is weak.
verses.decoded: Watch and pray so you won’t fall into temptation. The spirit is willing, but the body is weak.

verses.kjv: And again he went away, and prayed, and spake the same words.
verses.decoded: Again he went away and prayed, repeating the same words.

verses.kjv: And when he returned, he found them asleep again, (for their eyes were heavy,) neither wist they what to answer him.
verses.decoded: When he returned, he found them sleeping again because their eyes were heavy. They didn’t know what to say to him.

verses.kjv: And he cometh the third time, and saith unto them, Sleep on now, and take your rest: it is enough, the hour is come; behold, the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
verses.decoded: He came a third time and said to them, 'Sleep now and get some rest. It’s enough. The hour has come. The Son of Man is being betrayed into the hands of sinners.'

verses.kjv: Rise up, let us go; lo, he that betrayeth me is at hand.
verses.decoded: Get up, let’s go. The one who is betraying me is near.

verses.kjv: And immediately, while he yet spake, cometh Judas, one of the twelve, and with him a great multitude with swords and staves, from the chief priests and the scribes and the elders.
verses.decoded: Right then, while he was still speaking, Judas, one of the twelve, arrived with a large crowd armed with swords and clubs, sent by the chief priests, the teachers of the law, and the elders.

verses.kjv: And he that betrayed him had given them a token, saying, Whomsoever I shall kiss, that same is he; take him, and lead him away safely.
verses.decoded: The one who betrayed Jesus had arranged a signal: 'The one I kiss is the man. Arrest him and lead him away safely.'

verses.kjv: And as soon as he was come, he goeth straightway to him, and saith, Master, master; and kissed him.
verses.decoded: As soon as Judas arrived, he went straight to Jesus and said, 'Teacher, teacher!' and kissed him.

verses.kjv: And they laid their hands on him, and took him.
verses.decoded: They grabbed Jesus and arrested him.

verses.kjv: And one of them that stood by drew a sword, and smote a servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.
verses.decoded: One of the men standing there drew a sword and struck the servant of the high priest, cutting off his ear.

verses.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Are ye come out, as against a thief, with swords and with staves to take me?
verses.decoded: Jesus said to them, 'Are you coming out with swords and clubs to arrest me like a thief?'

verses.kjv: I was daily with you in the temple teaching, and ye took me not: but the scriptures must be fulfilled.
verses.decoded: I was with you every day in the temple teaching, but you didn’t arrest me. But the Scriptures must be fulfilled.'

verses.kjv: And they all forsook him, and fled.
verses.decoded: Then everyone left him and ran away.

verses.kjv: And there followed him a certain young man, having a linen cloth cast about his naked body; and the young men laid hold on him:
verses.decoded: A young man was following Jesus, wearing only a linen cloth wrapped around his body. The men grabbed him,

verses.kjv: And he left the linen cloth, and fled from them naked.
verses.decoded: but he left the cloth behind and ran away naked.

verses.kjv: And they led Jesus away to the high priest: and with him were assembled all the chief priests and the elders and the scribes.
verses.decoded: They took Jesus to the high priest, and all the chief priests, elders, and teachers of the law gathered there.

verses.kjv: And Peter followed him afar off, even into the palace of the high priest: and he sat with the servants, and warmed himself at the fire.
verses.decoded: Peter followed Jesus at a distance right into the courtyard of the high priest. He sat with the servants and warmed himself by the fire.

verses.kjv: And the chief priests and all the council sought for witness against Jesus to put him to death; and found none.
verses.decoded: The chief priests and the whole council were looking for evidence against Jesus to put him to death, but they found none.

verses.kjv: For many bare false witness against him, but their witness agreed not together.
verses.decoded: Many gave false testimony against him, but their statements did not agree.

verses.kjv: And there arose certain, and bare false witness against him, saying,
verses.decoded: Some stood up and gave false testimony against him, saying,

verses.kjv: We heard him say, I will destroy this temple that is made with hands, and within three days I will build another made without hands.
verses.decoded: 'We heard him say, "I will destroy this temple made with human hands and in three days I will build another, not made by hands."'

verses.kjv: But neither so did their witness agree together.
verses.decoded: But even then their testimony did not agree.

verses.kjv: And the high priest stood up in the midst, and asked Jesus, saying, Answerest thou nothing? what is it which these witness against thee?
verses.decoded: The high priest stood up, came before Jesus, and asked, 'Are you going to answer? What is this testimony against you?'

verses.kjv: But he held his peace, and answered nothing. Again the high priest asked him, and said unto him, Art thou the Christ, the Son of the Blessed?
verses.decoded: But Jesus remained silent and said nothing. Again the high priest asked him, 'Are you the Messiah, the Son of the Blessed One?'

verses.kjv: And Jesus said, I am: and ye shall see the Son of man sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.
verses.decoded: Jesus said, 'I am. And you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of power and coming with the clouds of heaven.'

verses.kjv: Then the high priest rent his clothes, and saith, What need we any further witnesses?
verses.decoded: Then the high priest tore his clothes and said, 'Why do we need any more witnesses?

verses.kjv: Ye have heard the blasphemy: what think ye? And they all condemned him to be guilty of death.
verses.decoded: You have heard the blasphemy. What do you think?' They all condemned him to be worthy of death.

verses.kjv: And some began to spit on him, and to cover his face, and to buffet him, and to say unto him, Prophesy: and the servants did strike him with the palms of their hands.
verses.decoded: Some began to spit on him, cover his face, hit him, and say to him, 'Prophesy!' The servants also hit him with their hands.

verses.kjv: And as Peter was beneath in the palace, there cometh one of the maids of the high priest:
verses.decoded: While Peter was below in the courtyard, a servant girl of the high priest came by.

verses.kjv: And when she saw Peter warming himself, she looked upon him, and said, And thou also wast with Jesus of Nazareth.
verses.decoded: When she saw Peter warming himself, she looked at him and said, 'You were with Jesus of Nazareth too.'

verses.kjv: But he denied, saying, I know not, neither understand I what thou sayest. And he went out into the porch; and the cock crew.
verses.decoded: But he denied it, saying, 'I don’t know what you’re talking about.' Then he went outside to the porch, and the rooster crowed.

verses.kjv: And a maid saw him again, and began to say to them that stood by, This is one of them.
verses.decoded: Another servant girl saw him and said to those standing nearby, 'This man is one of them.'

verses.kjv: And he denied it again. And a little after, they that stood by said again to Peter, Surely thou art one of them: for thou art a Galilaean, and thy speech agreeth thereto.
verses.decoded: He denied it again. A little later, those standing there said to Peter, 'Surely you are one of them, because you are a Galilean and your way of speaking shows it.'

verses.kjv: But he began to curse and to swear, saying, I know not this man of whom ye speak.
verses.decoded: But he began to curse and swear, 'I don’t know this man you’re talking about.'

verses.kjv: And the second time the cock crew. And Peter called to mind the word that Jesus said unto him, Before the cock crow twice, thou shalt deny me thrice. And when he thought thereon, he wept.
verses.decoded: The rooster crowed a second time. Then Peter remembered what Jesus had said to him: 'Before the rooster crows twice, you will deny me three times.' When he thought about this, he cried.

verses.kjv: And straightway in the morning the chief priests held a consultation with the elders and scribes and the whole council, and bound Jesus, and carried him away, and delivered him to Pilate.
verses.decoded: Early in the morning, the leading priests met with the elders, teachers, and the whole council. They tied up Jesus, took him away, and handed him over to Pilate.

verses.kjv: And Pilate asked him, Art thou the King of the Jews? And he answering said unto him, Thou sayest it.
verses.decoded: Pilate asked him, 'Are you the King of the Jews?' Jesus answered, 'You say that I am.'

verses.kjv: And the chief priests accused him of many things: but he answered nothing.
verses.decoded: The leading priests accused him of many things, but Jesus said nothing.

verses.kjv: And Pilate asked him again, saying, Answerest thou nothing? behold how many things they witness against thee.
verses.decoded: Pilate asked him again, 'Aren't you going to answer? Look at all the things they are accusing you of.'

verses.kjv: But Jesus yet answered nothing; so that Pilate marvelled.
verses.decoded: But Jesus still said nothing, which surprised Pilate.

verses.kjv: Now at that feast he released unto them one prisoner, whomsoever they desired.
verses.decoded: At that festival, Pilate would release one prisoner to the crowd, whoever they wanted.

verses.kjv: And the multitude crying aloud began to desire him to do as he had ever done unto them.
verses.decoded: The crowd loudly asked Pilate to do what he usually did for them.

verses.kjv: But Pilate answered them, saying, Will ye that I release unto you the King of the Jews?
verses.decoded: Pilate asked, 'Do you want me to release the King of the Jews to you?'

verses.kjv: For he knew that the chief priests had delivered him for envy.
verses.decoded: Pilate knew the leading priests had handed Jesus over because they were jealous.

verses.kjv: But the chief priests moved the people, that he should rather release Barabbas unto them.
verses.decoded: But the leading priests convinced the crowd to ask for Barabbas to be released instead.

verses.kjv: And Pilate answered and said again unto them, What will ye then that I shall do unto him whom ye call the King of the Jews?
verses.decoded: Pilate asked them again, 'What should I do with the one you call the King of the Jews?'

verses.kjv: And they cried out again, Crucify him.
verses.decoded: They shouted back, 'Crucify him!'

verses.kjv: Then Pilate said unto them, Why, what evil hath he done? And they cried out the more exceedingly, Crucify him.
verses.decoded: Pilate asked, 'What wrong has he done?' But they shouted even louder, 'Crucify him!'

verses.kjv: And so Pilate, willing to content the people, released Barabbas unto them, and delivered Jesus, when he had scourged him, to be crucified.
verses.decoded: Pilate wanted to please the crowd, so he released Barabbas to them. After having Jesus whipped, he handed him over to be crucified.

verses.kjv: And the soldiers led him away into the hall, called Praetorium; and they call together the whole band.
verses.decoded: The soldiers took Jesus into the hall called the Praetorium and gathered the whole group of soldiers together.

verses.kjv: And they clothed him with purple, and platted a crown of thorns, and put it about his head,
verses.decoded: They dressed him in a purple robe, made a crown of thorns, and put it on his head.

verses.kjv: And began to salute him, Hail, King of the Jews!
verses.decoded: Then they began to greet him, 'Hail, King of the Jews!'

verses.kjv: And they smote him on the head with a reed, and did spit upon him, and bowing their knees worshipped him.
verses.decoded: They hit him on the head with a stick, spit on him, and knelt down to mock him.

verses.kjv: And when they had mocked him, they took off the purple from him, and put his own clothes on him, and led him out to crucify him.
verses.decoded: After mocking him, they took off the purple robe, put his own clothes back on him, and led him out to be crucified.

verses.kjv: And they compel one Simon a Cyrenian, who passed by, coming out of the country, the father of Alexander and Rufus, to bear his cross.
verses.decoded: They forced a man named Simon from Cyrene, who was coming from the countryside and was the father of Alexander and Rufus, to carry Jesus' cross.

verses.kjv: And they bring him unto the place Golgotha, which is, being interpreted, The place of a skull.
verses.decoded: They took Jesus to a place called Golgotha, which means 'The place of the skull.'

verses.kjv: And they gave him to drink wine mingled with myrrh: but he received it not.
verses.decoded: They offered him wine mixed with myrrh, but he did not take it.

verses.kjv: And when they had crucified him, they parted his garments, casting lots upon them, what every man should take.
verses.decoded: After they crucified him, they divided his clothes by casting lots to decide who would get what.

verses.kjv: And it was the third hour, and they crucified him.
verses.decoded: It was the third hour when they crucified him.

verses.kjv: And the superscription of his accusation was written over, THE KING OF THE JEWS.
verses.decoded: Above him, they put a sign that said, 'THE KING OF THE JEWS.'

verses.kjv: And with him they crucify two thieves; the one on his right hand, and the other on his left.
verses.decoded: They crucified two criminals with him, one on his right and one on his left.

verses.kjv: And the scripture was fulfilled, which saith, And he was numbered with the transgressors.
verses.decoded: This fulfilled the scripture that says, 'He was counted among the criminals.'

verses.kjv: And they that passed by railed on him, wagging their heads, and saying, Ah, thou that destroyest the temple, and buildest it in three days,
verses.decoded: People passing by shook their heads and insulted him, saying, 'You who destroy the temple and build it in three days,'

verses.kjv: Save thyself, and come down from the cross.
verses.decoded: 'Save yourself and come down from the cross!'

verses.kjv: Likewise also the chief priests mocking said among themselves with the scribes, He saved others; himself he cannot save.
verses.decoded: The leading priests, mocking, said to each other with the teachers of the law, 'He saved others; he cannot save himself.'

verses.kjv: Let Christ the King of Israel descend now from the cross, that we may see and believe. And they that were crucified with him reviled him.
verses.decoded: Let the Messiah, the King of Israel, come down now from the cross, so we can see and believe. Those crucified with him also insulted him.

verses.kjv: And when the sixth hour was come, there was darkness over the whole land until the ninth hour.
verses.decoded: At noon, darkness came over the whole land until three in the afternoon.

verses.kjv: And at the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani? which is, being interpreted, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?
verses.decoded: At three o'clock, Jesus shouted loudly, 'Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani?' which means, 'My God, my God, why have you abandoned me?'

verses.kjv: And some of them that stood by, when they heard it, said, Behold, he calleth Elias.
verses.decoded: Some standing nearby heard this and said, 'Look, he is calling Elijah.'

verses.kjv: And one ran and filled a spunge full of vinegar, and put it on a reed, and gave him to drink, saying, Let alone; let us see whether Elias will come to take him down.
verses.decoded: Someone ran to get a sponge full of vinegar, put it on a stick, and gave it to him to drink, saying, 'Wait, let's see if Elijah will come to take him down.'

verses.kjv: And Jesus cried with a loud voice, and gave up the ghost.
